acceptanceCriteria: Root cause identified (test clock assumption vs product timestamp ordering) and linked to or separated from V1-0532.
The test passes 20/20 under parallel load (e.g. -count=20 with GOMAXPROCS contention) or the product fix is covered by a focused test.
body: Found by lane V1-1548 merge-forward (PR beamfall/corvint#1014, head 16aa9f861) on 2026-10-17, host load ~30-60. internal/tasks/cli TestATRV0013_FencedAttemptKillsTheDetachedCommand failed with 'recordedAt ... earlier than head receipt' (one-second skew); passed when rerun alone (9.9s). The test file is not touched by #1014. Possibly the same timestamp-ordering class as V1-0532 (claim/release timestamp refusal before lock acquisition). Expected: the test is deterministic under load, or the refusal is correct and the test tolerates it.
title: TestATRV0013_FencedAttemptKillsTheDetachedCommand flakes on 1s clock skew under load
